sources.title: Peligros geologicos y geohidrogeologicos detonados por el evento del Nino Costero 2017 en la Region Lima y parte de Ica
notes: The report states that it is a second deliverable for Lima and part of Ica and inventories 413 geological control points.

It explicitly contains 2017 affected-area, activation, damage and rehabilitation information, so its substantive territorial content remains sealed until the blind A1-A5 feature vectors are frozen and the anti-leakage gate passes.

It cites Luque and Rosado 2014 and INGEMMET Boletin 59 as earlier sources; those earlier sources remain the preferred lane for pre-unblind static geomorphic support when section-level masking is possible.
Pedregal is mentioned in the report conclusions but no Pedregal control-point coordinate was identified in this review; therefore this source does not resolve the current Pedregal A2 geometry gate.
Huaycoloro/Campoy and other Lima-East sectors are represented in the 2017 field evidence and are potentially valuable after unblind as spatially explicit territorial validation.
